verdict.rationale: Fly.io's docs vaguely claim that Machines 'boot in under a second... and scale out to tens of thousands when the traffic arrives' and that the same primitives work at any scale, implying some capacity for automatic scaling under load, but there is no documented autoscaling policy, trigger metric, or concurrency-based mechanism in the evidence. Multiple community reports describe outages, stuck/unreachable instances, and unreliable infrastructure under production load, undermining confidence that bursts are absorbed smoothly. missing for 10: explicit autoscaling configuration/trigger docs, independent benchmark of burst handling, resolution of reliability complaints during high load.
